测试 720*1280 4090 14b可以以左边开到29帧渲染，显存越小 block越要开高

动作幅度不大可以直接用单图参考提供稳定性(上面那个)
动作幅度大，尽量就用每段视频的尾帧（下面那个）

baigui,This is a  digital drawing featuring  a muscular, anthropomorphic white-furred creature name is baigui. Baigui has white fur covering most of his body, with a dark grey face, hands, and feet.  His eyes are red and fierce, and he has sharp, canine-like teeth. His fur is thick and fluffy, with tufts around his neck and chest.

如果想渲染全部视频
将红色链接到黄色上
